text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, after a training session with
Manhattan
Cafe...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Um... Would it be all right if we trained
for a little
longer?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
There are so many of them today... I
think I'll be
able to get some good
experience...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like she's seeing something
that I'm not.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Oh, they're calling me over... Could I...
go join
them?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
choice_data_list: 遅いから、今度にしない？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe runs around the track at
night,
alone...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But strangely enough, I feel like I can
hear the
footsteps of other runners...
And there's a sense
of whimsy to every
single one.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I'll let them know we'll have to do this
another
time...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe declines the unseen
entities'
offer, and we finish training for
the day.
